description: LSEG Agriculture Fundamentals is a commercial dataset of supply, demand and market indicators for about 60 agricultural commodity markets, covering production, consumption, inventories, trade flows, crop progress, weather impacts and information from government reports, for commodity forecasting, trading and risk management. It is produced by LSEG Data & Analytics, part of the London Stock Exchange Group, and is combined with LSEG pricing and reference data. Coverage spans North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Latin America and the Caribbean, with history from 1998 and end-of-day updates. Access is by paid subscription, delivered through Excel, APIs, web services, SFTP, cloud, desktop and bulk files in formats such as CSV, JSON and XML; prices are given on request. Caveats: the data are proprietary, the page read is a catalogue entry without methodology, and part of the content draws on public government reports. For simulation it supplies consistent commodity balance and trade flow series for models of food supply chain disruption, such as the effect of a harvest failure or export ban on regional availability and prices. It is related to the USDA WASDE record in this catalogue, one of the government reports it draws on.
